## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- env file not read — per caller instruction and the session's secret-read guard, no command read, printed or copied any env file; the clean clone and its env file were staged by the user. The env-file Configuration prerequisite is accepted on the user's attestation plus observed behavior (default DB URL used).
- Compose container recreation — running `docker compose up -d --wait` from the clone recreated the shared `postgres` container with its init bind mount pointing at the clone; `docker compose up -d --wait` was run once from the original checkout afterwards and the mount points back to it. The named volume `aurora_pgdata` was kept. `aurora-restore` (a README command) reset the `aurora` database to its initial data.
- Document surface — not in the evaluator's pyramid list; treated as a static-file surface and executed before E2E.
- `tests` gate — `tests/conftest.py` pins `DATABASE_URL` to `aurora_test`, so the injected `eval_f12_2026-10-14T15-04-32Z` DB was not used by the suite (it ran against the compose PostgreSQL as the gate description requires).
